name: Geospatial Spatiotemporal Fusion Pipeline Template
summary: Reusable base CDG for geospatial, satellite, GNSS, crop, wildfire, mobility, and environmental forecasting tasks that combine spatial tiling, temporal aggregation, external rasters, spatial validation, and constrained post-processing.
dejargonized_summary: Join location, time, sensor, raster, weather, road, or census data; build spatial and temporal features; validate by location or time; train fused models; and apply geographic constraints or smoothing.

inputs.name: spatial_temporal_records
inputs.constraints: Coordinates, timestamps, sensor measurements, rasters, or external geographic attributes.

outputs.name: geo_predictions
outputs.constraints: Predictions aligned to locations, times, tiles, or tracks.

use_when: The task requires spatial coordinates, time windows, satellite imagery, GNSS tracks, road networks, weather, climate, crop, or wildfire context.
Validation must avoid spatial or temporal leakage.
do_not_use_when: The task has no location, time, sensor, raster, or geographic grouping structure.
Spatial or temporal metadata is incidental and ordinary grouped validation plus a base ML CDG is sufficient.
applicability.key_insight: The load-bearing topology is fusion of spatial and temporal context before leakage-safe validation and geographic correction.

swappable_stages.fusion_model: Can be LightGBM, CatBoost, CNN/ViT, sequence model, or hybrid late fusion.

applicability.scaling_notes: Cache expensive raster joins and use tiled processing for large imagery or tracks.
failure_modes: Random validation folds overestimate performance when nearby locations or adjacent times leak.
External rasters can be misaligned by projection, resolution, or timestamp.

planning_constraints.subject: geo_temporal_alignment_before_features
planning_constraints.statement: Align coordinate reference systems, timestamps, tiles, tracks, and external rasters before deriving spatial-temporal features.
planning_constraints.rationale: Feature extraction assumes that geography and time are already joined on compatible keys and projections.

planning_constraints.subject: spatial_temporal_leakage_guard
planning_constraints.statement: Use location, tile, group, track, or time-aware validation before trusting fusion-model scores.
planning_constraints.rationale: Random folds can overstate performance when nearby places, adjacent times, or repeated tracks leak across splits.

audit.rationale: Added after expansion validation left repeated unmatched geospatial and spatiotemporal fusion pipelines with location/time joins and leakage-safe validation as load-bearing stages.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This captures tasks where location, time, sensors, rasters, tracks, or weather must be fused before modeling and constrained post-processing.
uncertainty_notes: Future ingestion should split reusable raster, map-matching, GNSS, and weather feature operations into refinements where appropriate.

references.title: Sciona expansion support-3 validation audit
references.note: Local deterministic and semantic audit of unmatched solution patterns.

stages.name: Geospatial Temporal Join
stages.description: Join coordinates, timestamps, tracks, rasters, weather, road networks, census, soil, bioclim, or other external geographic context.
stages.dejargonized_description: Attach relevant location and time context to each example.
preconditions: Coordinate reference systems and timestamps are known.
guarantees: Each example has aligned geographic context.

stages.name: Spatial Temporal Features
stages.description: Create distance, tile, rolling window, lag, seasonal, raster, road-network, or neighborhood aggregate features.
stages.dejargonized_description: Convert location and time context into model-ready features.

stages.name: Leakage-Safe Geo Validation
stages.description: Use spatial, temporal, grouped, rolling-window, or tile-based cross-validation to avoid geographic leakage.
stages.dejargonized_description: Split validation by place, time, track, tile, user, or other leakage boundary.
preconditions: Group or time boundaries are available.
guarantees: Validation respects spatial and temporal leakage boundaries.

stages.name: Fusion Model
stages.description: Train a tree, neural, image, sequence, or hybrid fusion model over spatial, temporal, sensor, and external features.
stages.dejargonized_description: Train the model that combines geographic, time, and sensor evidence.
guarantees: Predictions align to the requested locations/times.

stages.name: Geographic Postprocessing
stages.description: Apply map matching, smoothing, zero-sum correction, clipping, neighborhood consistency, or constraint-aware aggregation.
stages.dejargonized_description: Correct predictions using known geographic or temporal constraints.
guarantees: Outputs are formatted and geographically consistent.
